note: Reusable documentary design system. Each look maps to an AUTHENTIC upstream engine (verified pixel-identical or within the JPEG floor to the repo's own renderer; see references/visual-fidelity-report.md) plus shared tokens, so scenes from different engines read as one film. Scene field `look` applies the preset; scene values always win.

color_semantics.alert: deception, fake, contested or classified: never used for decoration

typography.engine_internal: Upstream engines keep their own bundled faces (huashu PuHui for kinetic type, lemo whiteboard EMS single-line hand, animate kit hand lettering). Those are part of the authentic look and are not replaced.
typography.fonts_source: tools/fonts (OFL, fetched by scripts/fetch_fonts.py; manifest tools/fonts/manifest.json)

motion.camera: upstream engines run their own camera; the studio adds none (no breathing zoom) unless the scene sets camera
motion.sync: beats are anchored to narration words (cue:word), never to fixed seconds when a word exists
motion.transitions: hard cuts inside a look; morph bridges only inside animate pieces; dissolve or match-cut when the look changes

layout.no_empty_holds: a scene never holds a frame that is mostly empty background for more than the first quarter of its time
